column1: # mapping_set_title: AOP-Wiki biological actions to PATO qualities
#   Maps the 11 biological action values in the AOP-Wiki controlled vocabulary
#   (as exported in the nightly XML dump's biological-action elements; subject
#   ids use AOP-Wiki's own source_id for each action) to PATO quality terms,
#   for use as the direction/quality component of Key Event nodes in the
#   aop_cam schema. All PATO ids and labels verified against the PATO release
#   current on the mapping_date, via OAK (sqlite:obo:pato).
# subject_source_version: AOP-Wiki nightly dump 2026-11-09 (sha256 pinned in data/aopwiki-snapshot.yaml)
# object_source_version: PATO release current on 2026-11-09, via OAK sqlite:obo:pato

column11: Generic directional quality; pair with the process/object term for the full EQ reading.
Generic directional quality; pair with the process/object term for the full EQ reading.
AOP-Wiki means a direction-neutral change in functionality; PATO has no "altered functionality", so the bearer quality is the closest fit.
AOP-Wiki uses "occurrence" for an event that happens at all; "present" is the nearest PATO quality.
PATO has no "disrupted"; disorganized is the nearest quality for disrupted structure or process.
Direction-neutral change in morphology; PATO has no "altered morphology", so the bearer attribute is used.
